decisions_made.rationale: User said 'forget about 1.3 and any release completely'. Commits stay on main as forward progress, not anchored to a release.

decisions_made.decision: Computer Keyboard auto-selected on launch even if user previously had Guitar Audio
decisions_made.rationale: Surprise hot mic on launch is a worse UX than asking the user to re-opt-in to guitar. Real MIDI device selections still persist.

decisions_made.decision: Normalizer brush/scrape rejection gated on Idle | Attack only (not Sustain or Decay)
decisions_made.rationale: McLeod runs with adaptive_clarity filter in Sustain/Decay -> confidence=0.0 on legit vibrato peaks -> false rejection. Discovered by round-2 critic, extended in round 3.

decisions_made.decision: Live calibration hot-swap via try_lock with 5-attempt retry
decisions_made.rationale: Audio thread holds inner mutex ~2-2.5ms of every 2.7ms callback. Single try_lock has 10-20% hit rate; 5 attempts over ~5ms reliably lands.

decisions_made.decision: Calibration profile re-apply gated on disk mtime change
decisions_made.rationale: Spam was 1-2 applies/sec because UI polls status on focus. Cache LAST_APPLIED_MTIME, skip when unchanged.
All MIDI/IO concerns now in I/O tab. Harmony tab is pure harmony controls. One canonical surface per concern.

context_notes: Session was deeply iterative: brutal-critic spawned -> fix -> re-critic -> fix loop, 4 rounds total. User interleaved live manual-QA reports from the running build that surfaced real bugs the critic agents had missed (visual layout, FTUX behavior, runtime spam). Each fix was committed and pushed atomically. The pattern of 'critic agent -> live user QA' was very effective at catching different bug classes — critics caught architectural issues, live QA caught UX surprises. Resume by running the round-4 critic on the current state (post-9e6af50a) OR by waiting for user QA feedback on the latest build.

anti_patterns_discovered.manifestation: synthetic_pluck_above_profile_floor_can_produce_events accepted 0 events as 'valid' in its own comment. Wide-pass-band assertions (0.0 < x < 0.5) hid regressions. Test for ascending-melody contrary motion asserted result.len() == 2 instead of the contrary motion itself.
anti_patterns_discovered.prevention_mechanism: Brutal-critic agents flag any test where the assertion accepts the null/zero/empty case as success. Tightened to ±1e-6 epsilon against actual computed values. Statistical tests use contrary > parallel instead of contrary_rate >= 0.5 (the latter requires achievable contrary, which register constraints sometimes prevent).

anti_patterns_discovered.manifestation: Calibration profile stored on GuitarInput.normalizer but never read in process_block (round-1 critic). Then store-with-only-startup-application (round-2 critic). Then store-without-live-hot-swap-on-save (round-3 critic). Each fix moved the problem one layer deeper.
anti_patterns_discovered.prevention_mechanism: Trace data flow end-to-end before declaring a feature 'wired'. Brutal-critic round prompts must explicitly verify the data is READ by downstream consumers, not just written. Live QA on the running app catches what static analysis misses.

anti_patterns_discovered.pattern: Killing the dev server out from under the user's webview
anti_patterns_discovered.manifestation: When I killed cargo tauri dev / vite dev during debugging, the user's Tauri webview lost its HMR WebSocket. The webview appears to render but all subsequent click handlers may fail because the JS bundle can't reload. User reported 'Start button isn't working' for this reason.
anti_patterns_discovered.prevention_mechanism: Don't kill dev servers while debugging — leave them running. If a dev server must be restarted, tell the user to close + reload the Tauri webview.

anti_patterns_discovered.manifestation: FTUX restored a saved selectedInput=Guitar Audio sentinel on launch and auto-started routing -> hot mic on app open. Guitar requires explicit configuration (device, channel, gain) — should not auto-restart.
anti_patterns_discovered.prevention_mechanism: Audio-input sources that consume the microphone or require per-session config should never auto-restore on launch. They should require an explicit click after launch.
